lines.trans: Let us just eat anything.
Even if you pitch zero show ideas, at least voice an opinion at lunch! Let us eat whatever you are craving.
Blood-sausage soup?
Ugh, way too hot out for that!
Gimbap?
Come on, are you not sick of eating that every single day in the editing room?!
Risotto?
Man, you and I really do not click on any wavelength—what kind of bland pick is risotto?!
Then please just eat whatever you would like to eat, Senior.
I am going to have spicy mixed noodles!

맞다.gloss: to be right, to be correct
